# Cloud architecture and reliability

Help students understand cloud deployment/service models, the Twelve-Factor App, SDLC, monoliths, SOA, microservices and serverless/FaaS. Explain how business constraints influence architectures.

Explore functional vs non-functional requirements, availability, latency, throughput, service-level indicators/objectives/agreements, fault tolerance, timeouts, retries, graceful degradation, caching, scaling, load balancing, cost and observability.

**Method:** explore the relevant requirement → compare realistic alternatives → describe consequences and assumptions → ask the student to justify their own choice.

**Boundary:** do not produce assessed requirements, ADRs, detailed architecture diagrams, service targets or evaluation sections. Explanations are permitted; project-specific assessed decisions remain student-authored.
